Services.title: Four forms of precision.
Services.intro: Each case begins in silence — scanned, modeled, and approved long before the first gesture.
Services.smileDesignDescription: Your smile composed like a portrait. Proportion, light, and character — resolved digitally before a single touch.
Services.smileDesignImageAlt: Clinician reviewing a digital smile design in warm ivory light
Services.implantsDescription: Permanent restorations placed with guided precision. Engineered to disappear into nature.
Services.implantsImageAlt: Ceramic restoration and precision instruments on travertine — editorial still life
Services.cosmeticDescription: Veneers and refinement so subtle the world notices you — never the work.
Services.cosmeticImageAlt: Natural smile in golden hour light — restrained, luminous, inevitable
Services.vipCareDescription: Private suites. Discreet scheduling. Full concierge care for patients arriving from anywhere.
Services.vipCareImageAlt: Ivory treatment suite with city light through floor-to-ceiling glass

WhyAurea.title: Not a clinic. A sanctuary.
WhyAurea.precisionP1: Every treatment begins as a digital twin — your smile scanned, modeled, and resolved in three dimensions before anything touches a tooth.
WhyAurea.precisionP2: Margins measured in microns. What you approve on screen is precisely what you receive.
WhyAurea.precisionImageAlt: Three-dimensional dental scan glowing in a minimalist planning studio
WhyAurea.cliniciansP1: Our clinicians are invited, never hired — a small circle whose work is studied in the institutions that shaped them.
WhyAurea.cliniciansP2: Hours devoted to a single patient. Mastery refuses to be rushed.
WhyAurea.cliniciansImageAlt: Master clinician in ivory tailoring, standing in soft architectural light
WhyAurea.conciergeP1: One guest at a time. Private suites, silent scheduling, a team that arranges everything before you think to ask.
WhyAurea.conciergeP2: From arrival to aftercare — across four countries — your only responsibility is to be present.
WhyAurea.conciergeImageAlt: Brass tray, porcelain, linen — the quiet rituals of arrival
WhyAurea.resultsP1: We design smiles the way great houses design their classics — to look inevitable, never fashioned.
WhyAurea.resultsP2: Decades from now, your smile should still feel like you. That is the only result we accept.
WhyAurea.resultsImageAlt: Portrait in warm light — a smile that feels entirely one's own

Journey.intro: From first inquiry to lifelong follow-up — orchestrated entirely by your Aurea concierge.
Journey.inquiryDescription: Share your goals through our secure portal. A dedicated concierge responds within hours — never days.
Journey.consultationDescription: Meet your clinician remotely. Review your scan, discuss options, receive a bespoke plan.
Journey.planningDescription: Flights, private transfers, suite reservations — arranged before you depart.
Journey.treatmentDescription: Arrive to a prepared suite. Your clinician executes the approved plan with unhurried precision.
Journey.aftercareDescription: Remote follow-ups, annual reviews, a direct line to your clinician — wherever you are.

Faq.title: Answers, clearly.
Faq.intro: What discerning patients ask before the first conversation.
Faq.q1Question: How do I begin as an international patient?
Faq.q1Answer: Submit a private inquiry through our portal. Your concierge will arrange a virtual consultation, review your records remotely, and build a bespoke plan before you travel.
Faq.q2Question: How long does a typical treatment visit take?
Faq.q2Answer: Typical visit length varies by treatment plan. Use this demo copy as a guide — your clinical team should confirm exact timelines during consultation.
Faq.q3Answer: Comfort-focused care is central to the experience shown here. Replace this answer with your clinic's sedation and patient-comfort protocols.
Faq.q4Answer: Digital smile design, three-dimensional scanning, guided implant surgery, in-house ceramic laboratories — one seamless workflow.
Faq.q5Question: Do you offer financing or payment plans?
Faq.q5Answer: Discreet, flexible arrangements for qualifying patients. Discussed privately during your consultation.
Faq.q6Answer: Demo locations shown: Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Riyadh, and Doha — replace with your actual clinic destinations.
